sloka: प्रभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् ।शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा ।। ६.५८.५६ ।।।।
transliteration: prabhinnaśirasastasya bahu susrāva śoṇitam ।śarīrādapi susrāva gireḥ prasravaṇaṁ yathā ।। 6.58.56 ।।।।

translations.english: Life, splendour, strength, and senses departed Prahastha fell instantly on the ground like a tree cut at the bottom.
